$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — LLM commander DUEL (DESIGN_LLM_Commander §8, §11 L-4 pre-test; STATUS_Backend_LLM_Commander.md §Duel): llm-platoon-attack with Red under a seat too — Blue's Platoon over Alpha Squad and Bravo Squad, Red Platoon over the Defenders (at the sheds) and Reserve. The rows judge the PLUMBING of two seats on opposite sides — each side's squads report to their OWN commander, never the other's; both sides fight; the fight lasts — not who wins (two copies of one model say little about either). The model logs (commander-<id>.jsonl, one per seat) carry the rest. FEATURE scenario, no golden: a model run is not repeatable.

expect.name: Alpha Squad reports to Blue's Platoon
Bravo Squad reports to Blue's Platoon
the Defenders report to Red Platoon
the Reserve reports to Red Platoon
no Red squad reports to Blue's Platoon (each seat reads only its own side)
